description: Lučka uprava Rijeka is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lučka uprava Rijeka. The Port of Rijeka Authority was established for the management, construction and use of the port of Rijeka. Coverage: Lučka uprava Rijeka. The portal shows the English title as "Port of Rijeka Authority" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lučka uprava Rijeka. Its keywords include Promet. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
